title: xAI rebrands to SpaceXAI and debuts a new logo (Kelsey Vlamis/Business Insider)
summary: Kelsey Vlamis / Business Insider: xAI rebrands to SpaceXAI and debuts a new logo — - xAI has officially been rebranded to SpaceXAI. — The change follows SpaceX's historic IPO and acquisition of xAI earlier this year. — Elon Musk previously said xAI would be dissolved and folded into SpaceX. — xAI is no more.
contentText:
Kelsey Vlamis / Business Insider :

xAI rebrands to SpaceXAI and debuts a new logo   —  - xAI has officially been rebranded to SpaceXAI.  — The change follows SpaceX's historic IPO and acquisition of xAI earlier this year.  — Elon Musk previously said xAI would be dissolved and folded into SpaceX.  —  xAI is no more.
